The first shape of the market will come from the top graded names, positional scarcity and how aggressively clubs want to replace production already on the roster.

fa_declaration.retry.title.v2: {player_name} passes on KBO FA market for now
fa_declaration.retry.body:
{player_link} of {team_link} has decided not to file for free agency this time. The eligibility was there, but the player chose one more season to rebuild leverage before entering the market.

The Grade {grade} candidate stays with his original club for now. For the team, it preserves a familiar roster piece; for the player, the next FA window now depends on turning the coming season into a stronger platform.
